valuation_multiple.name: valuation_multiple
assumptions: Revenue base: Consolidated revenue from operations, FY25 (year ended 31 March 2025), statutory basis, per press reporting. (as_of=2025-03-31).
valuation_multiple.interpretation: Below the commonly cited 10x-30x growth-stage revenue-multiple heuristic band. Heuristic only, not a valuation opinion.
